claims.claim: Real VS Code layout and editor group primitives
claims.scope: Extracted primitives with a separate pane shell, not the full workbench.

claims.scope: The host registers a PaneExtension and supplies its view lifecycle.

claims.claim: Separate pane zoom from 50 to 200 percent
claims.scope: Content zoom; the tab strip stays at the host scale.

claims.claim: Layout, drafts, active panes and editor positions survive refresh
claims.scope: Demo browser storage for each folder; custom applications must supply storage.

claims.claim: Shared theme with live preview, Apply and Cancel
claims.scope: The demo connects the controller to editor and terminal themes.

claims.claim: Workspace search groups matches and supports filters
claims.scope: Local ripgrep adapter; 1,000 matches, 4 MiB files and 15-second limit.
TypeScript and JavaScript, relative imports and local workspace package exports.

claims.claim: Local file, Git and shell adapters
claims.scope: Bun local host; custom applications can supply their own providers.
Generated archives, not a claim of public registry publication.

claims.claim: 1,174 archived source files with SHA-256 verification
21 host operation IDs with CLI and host HTTP adapters
claims.scope: Pane actions also use direct browser SDK APIs. Package inspection is not full operation coverage.

limits: No bundled VS Code extension host, marketplace or debugger.
